definitions.edge: symmetric nearest gradient edge distance, Sobel magnitude >20/255; distances in source pixels
definitions.flicker: mean absolute change of edge-distance error after known rigid motion alignment, truth raster variation subtracted
definitions.uncertainty: occlusion/turn/flash/cut excluded from rigid temporal claims; spatial measurements retained
definitions.ssim: Gaussian sigma1.5 truncate10/3, Rec.709 gamma-coded luma, border5 excluded
definitions.ghost: luma MAE in 2-source-pixel truth-edge band; proxy, not semantic ghost detection
definitions.thickness: synthetic 4 bright lines, mean thresholded scanline width error; not general stroke width
definitions.postTruth: C/D truth uses identical production postprocess, after inference on separate GPU device
